name: Sukhi's Gourmet Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice (Costco 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Boneless chicken breast in a creamy tomato tikka sauce paired with fluffy basmati rice. Basmati rice is exceptionally easy to digest, though the curry sauce contains cream and tomato spices best suited for remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm thoroughly and mix chicken with plenty of basmati rice to temper the rich curry sauce. Drink with water.
